summary: Backend API regression and UI integration testing completed against public URL. Core flows pass (config, validations, claim, referral, public card, responsive, error states), with one reproducible wallet edit/rebind UI blocker.

ui_bugs.issue: After wallet is bound, clicking edit button does not unlock wallet input; input remains disabled so rebind cannot be performed.

action_items: Fix wallet edit flow so clicking edit reliably toggles draft.bound=false and enables wallet input for rebind before claim.
After fix, retest wallet edit/rebind plus full claim gating path in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Wallet edit action appears non-functional in runtime despite edit button being visible and force-clicked; this blocks a required user path (edit and rebind).
Good practice observed: backend response models consistently exclude wallet/request_id/consent/private fields from public endpoints.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data kept. All test_ records cleaned from Mongo after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested. pytest suite added and passing (13/13). UI referral flow validated in fresh draft via ?ref=CODE and second claim succeeded. Unknown route/ref graceful page verified. Mobile widths 390/375/320 show no horizontal overflow on home/console. API unavailable UI state and retry button visibility verified. Mongo cleanup done; stats/recent returned 0/empty post-cleanup.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: complete 4 tasks -> bind wallet -> click edit wallet icon. Expected: wallet input enabled and user can type new address. Actual: input remains disabled (is_disabled stayed True before and after click). Likely root cause is state transition from bound=true to bound=false not being applied/observed in the rendered WalletForm path (event/state update not taking effect), causing disabled expression (!unlocked || draft.bound || !!draft.result) to remain true.
